Applying to the Graduate Program
Graduate Application
The application deadline is December 1st for admission the following Fall (only applications for Fall semester are considered) A complete application consists of the following materials:
Application and fee through Office of Admissions (The application fee is required, and the Department does not offer a fee waiver).
Copies of your transcripts and degree certificates in original language and English translation
Statement of Purpose
Three letters of recommendations
TOEFL/IELTS test scores (International Applicants Only)
GRE Scores less than five years old (Optional)
DO NOT mail these documents to the department; the department will not accept any paper or hard copies. If you would like to send your official transcripts please send to the address below. PLEASE NOTE: This is not required unless you are offered admission to the program.
Graduate Admissions Office
University of Florida
201 Criser Hall
PO Box 114000
Gainesville, FL 32611-4000
2. Report your official GRE and TOEFL scores (if applicable) electronically through ETS using school code 5812. A department code is not necessary. GRE scores are valid for 5 years and are no longer required but you are encouraged to submit if available.
TOEFL Minimums: 213 on computer-based; 80 on Internet-based. UF’s school code for submission of TOEFL scores is 5812. You may substitute for TOEFL with:
IELTS with a minimum score of 6; or
MELAB with a minimum score of 77
If you think you may be exempt from TOEFL, please review the list of countries that are exempt from TOEFL. If your name on your ETS scorecard does not EXACTLY match your name on your UF application, your scores may not be posted to your application.
Application Status Inquiries
You can check the receipt of materials by the Office of Admissions by clicking the Check Your Status button. The Office of Admissions’ Online Status page will only reflect information concerning materials forwarded directly to the Office of Admissions.
